title: Campaign Reports
meta: A plain English report on your campaign results with wins, misses and clear next steps. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Campaign reports that tell you what to do next
overview: Dashboards are easy to ignore, so we turn your numbers into a short report you will read. You give us viewer access to your ad accounts, email tool and analytics. We pull the figures, use AI tools to spot patterns and a person to explain them in plain words. The report covers what worked, what did not, why we think so and what to try next month, with one chart per point and no jargon.

pkgs.blurb: A one page report for a single channel.
A full report across three channels with next month actions.
Two months compared, with a call and a testing roadmap.

faq: This is a fixed report for the period you choose. If you want it every month, we quote a monthly option separately after we see how the first report goes and how much data you have.
Viewer access to your ad accounts, email tool and analytics, shared through their own invite systems. We never need passwords and never change your campaigns while we prepare a report.
Will you tell me bad news?
Yes, kindly and clearly. A report that hides weak spots is no use. We explain what the numbers suggest, how sure we are and what small test would give you a clearer answer.
Can you read numbers from a spreadsheet?
Yes. If some of your data lives in sheets or exports, we can include it. Send the files and tell us the period, and we match them to the platform data.
